settings.title: Settings
settings.createChannelFolderDesc: Create author folder for batch archives
settings.timeGroupDesc: Organize by time within channel folder
settings.groupByYearDesc: Create year subfolders within author folder
settings.downloadCompletionActionDesc: Action to run when a download finishes
settings.externalReceiveModeDesc: When a link arrives from the browser extension or phone (always auto-starts download)
settings.concurrentFragmentsDesc: Concurrent connections per large file (1-8, default 3)
settings.forceMultithreadDesc: Concurrent downloads across platforms. Use a proxy to reduce ban risk (experimental).
settings.speedLimitDesc: Global speed limit (0 for unlimited, KB/s)
settings.gpuTurboDesc: Maximize GPU performance for AI processing and transcoding
settings.imageConfigDesc: Configure cloud API keys for image upscaling, enhancement, and restoration.
settings.shortcutHint: Click area and press new key combination to modify
settings.shortcutPasteDesc: Paste link from clipboard and auto-parse
settings.shortcutQueueDesc: Add current video to archive queue
settings.shortcutCancelDesc: Cancel current process or close modal
settings.cleanupDesc: Temporary files are cleaned automatically when the app exits.
settings.errorReportingDesc: Help improve MediaFlow. Only anonymized crash logs are sent.
settings.sendTestReportDesc: For development: verify remote logging works.
settings.aiModelDesc: View and manage downloaded local AI resources (e.g., denoise models). Uninstalled models will be redownloaded when needed.
settings.uninstallConfirm: Are you sure you want to uninstall this AI model? It will need to be redownloaded if you use the feature again.
settings.engineDesc: Manage external binaries and AI environments required for MediaFlow. Keeping them updated improves success rate.
settings.autoUpdateEnginesDesc: Automatically update engines when new versions are detected
settings.engineUpdateFound: Found new versions for core components. Update recommended.
settings.engineNoUpdate: All core components are up to date.
settings.engineNotes1: * yt-dlp supports in-place updates. AI environments might be slow to download, please keep your network connection stable.
settings.engineNotes2: * Updating components will not affect your local settings or downloaded content.
settings.aboutDesc: MediaFlow relies on these great open-source tools to run stably.
settings.licenseNotice: The core of this project is driven by yt-dlp and FFmpeg. We strictly comply with the respective open-source licenses and use these binary files in an aggregate distribution mode.
settings.storageTimeout: Scan timed out, manual cleanup recommended
settings.clipboardWatchDesc: Shows a system notification for downloadable links; click it to open the app (off by default)
settings.clipboardDetectModeDesc: Strict = major platforms only; Balanced = more sites + direct media + common video paths; Loose = almost any deep link (more false positives)
settings.openLogsFolderDesc: Open local app logs for troubleshooting (nothing is uploaded automatically)
settings.cleanupConfirmMessage:
Are you sure you want to clear all temporary files and cache now?
This will not affect your downloaded files but will free up disk space.
settings.testReportDoneDesc: Check your Google Sheet for a new TEST_REPORT row.
settings.restartToLoad: Please restart to load new features.
settings.binaryFallbackNote: If tools are still missing after reinstall, open Settings → Core engines.
settings.binaryMissingToast: Missing tools: {{list}}. Open Settings → Core engines to fix.
settings.themeDesc: Switch between light and dark UI (light is default)
settings.pageSubtitle: Common options first. Advanced sections stay collapsed.
settings.sectionCloudDesc: Only needed for cloud translation. Keys are stored per provider on this device — configure the one you use. Image enhance uses local engines (no cloud key).
settings.multiKeyHint: Optional: add multiple keys for rotation
settings.apiOneProviderTip: Pick a default provider → paste key → Save. Switching providers loads that provider’s saved key.
settings.imageApiTip: Separate from translation. Only the current image provider’s key is required.
settings.providerHintOpenRouter: OpenAI-compatible gateway — one key can route many models. Good single entry point.
settings.providerHintOpenAI: Official OpenAI API. Also used by many OpenAI-compatible tools.
settings.providerHintMultiKey: Optional multi-key rotation is available below for rate-limit resilience.
settings.donationDesc: MediaFlow is completely free and open source. If it helps you, consider buying the author a coffee.
